dialogues.speaker: Onyx Agate
dialogues.text: #Greetings, {NICKNAME}. I've been told that you will be my trial. I do hope that the experience would be enjoyable for us both.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: "Courtesy is the air of the civilized. While it is present, it passes unnoticed; yet once it is withdrawn, its absence is immediately and keenly felt..."

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: That was the lesson Major Valeriy taught me when I first enlisted... Though these were not his exact words, it was, I believe, what he meant.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Major Valeriy is one of the people I respect most. And I take great care not to utter so much as a single crude word while I am in camp here.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: After being assigned under the Lady Marionette, even when I had an unfortunate clash with the Frostmoon Scions and had eggs thrown at my face...

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: I still didn't resort to insults or violence, instead, I tried my best to reason things out with them.

choices.text: You've got quite a good temper.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Hmm. The only time I lost it in these past years was upon learning that the Lady Marionette had met with a mishap.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: While I have never received a direct order from the Lady Marionette herself, her Bosco Landcruisers are undeniably reliable and durable.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: To become a steadfast war machine like the Bosco has been my lifelong pursuit.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: When the Wild Hunt and that unreasonable monster stormed the Experimental Design Bureau, my blade was chipped from all the fighting, yet I still couldn't stop them.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: If not for the Bosco Landcruiser there helping me break through, I would not have survived at the docks.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Ah, though I nearly perished later in an energy field cast by another one of the Eleven... But that's another story.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: When I learned of the news while lying in the hospital... I was plunged into utter shock and terror.

choices.text: That's all in the past now...

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Yes, you did... Speaking solely for myself, I would like to offer you my utmost respect.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Now that I'm under the command of Major Valeriy again, I may soon make my return to Snezhnaya.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: I suppose that to have received your guidance here in Nod-Krai before I return would make my tour here all the more honorable.

choices.text: My companions and I defeated the culprit...
There aren't many Fatui soldiers like you.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Certainly. You can beat me up until I end up on all fours, and that would suit me just fine.
